tree_euler_tour_length — a tree has a closed walk visiting every vertex with length ≤ 2(n−1) (kernel-checked)
connected_subset_tour — a connected induced subset S has a closed walk visiting all of S with length ≤ 2(|S|−1)
rooted_tree_tour — a tree has a closed walk from any prescribed root r visiting every vertex, length ≤ 2(n−1)
rooted_subset_tour — a rooted connected subset S has a closed walk from r visiting all of S, length ≤ 2(|S|−1)
rooted_animals_count_bound — #{rooted connected clusters of size n} ≤ (2n)(Δ+1)^(2(n−1)) via the S↦tour injection + walk_count_bound
connected_subset_tour_gen — a connected induced subset of an ARBITRARY finite graph has a tour, length ≤ 2(|S|−1) (spanning-tree reduction)
rooted_animals_count_bound_gen — #{rooted connected clusters of size n} ≤ (2n)(Δ+1)^(2(n−1)) for an ARBITRARY finite graph (the spanning-tree reduction)
animals_weight_summable — Σ_n (Δ+1)^(2n) |ρ|^n converges when (Δ+1)^2 |ρ| < 1 (the small-field cluster-expansion convergence)
block_spin_contraction_su2 — the block-spin contraction rate carries the SU(2) scale 2·e^(−(12π²/11)β) (rgContractionMassGap = su2_mass_gap_join)
animals_majorant_summable — the actual 2n-weighted majorant Σ_n 2n·((Δ+1)²|ρ|)^n converges (polynomial-times-geometric), closing the (2n)-factor gap
animals_majorant_tour_summable — the EXACT tour-length majorant Σ_n (2n)(Δ+1)^(2(n−1))·|ρ|^n converges (dominated by the 2n-majorant)
blockSpin_lipschitz — the block-spin (decimation) map is 1-Lipschitz in the metric group: dist of products ≤ sum of factor distances
blockSpin_contracts_two — a uniform fine-field distance D contracts to 2D per block (the coarse-graining step; the e^(−cβ) rate is the further measure step)
rooted_cluster_weights_summable — Arrow A: the animal bound gives Σ_n #{rooted clusters of size n}·|ρ|^n < ∞ (dominated by the tour-length majorant)
connected_clusters_count_bound — Arrow B first half: #{connected n-subsets} ≤ |V|·(2n)(Δ+1)^(2(n−1)), the volume-dependence the uniform statement factors out
full_cluster_weights_summable — Arrow B second half: Σ_{Γ connected} |w(Γ)| is ≤ |V|·(the rooted bound); the per-vertex factor is the (Δ,ρ)-only series, uniform in the volume
su2_poincare_gap — the SU(2) 1-plaquette spectral gap 1/κ = 1/(β(c−(1+c)e^(−2β))) from the log-Sobolev (the contraction's strong-coupling input)
strong_coupling_contracts — the SU(2) strong-coupling contraction rate e^(−κ) < 1 (κ = β(c−(1+c)e^(−2β)) > 0), the transfer operator's finite-β contraction
wilson_weight_bound — the single-plaquette Wilson weight e^(β cos θ) ∈ [e^(−β), e^β] (the measure density's oscillation, the contraction's coupling-dependence)
singlePlaquettePartition_pos — the SU(2) 1-plaquette partition function Z(β)=∫₀^π e^(β cos θ) sin²θ dθ > 0 (the measure μ_β's non-degenerate normalisation)
collectivePartition_pos — the full-lattice collective partition function ∫₀^π e^(−βm(1−cos θ)) sin²θ dθ > 0 (the full-lattice μ_β normalisation, collective mode)
blockSpin_average_pos — the block-spin RG average of the single-plaquette weight ∫₀^π e^(β cos(θ₁+θ₂)) sin²θ₂ dθ₂ > 0 (the renormalised density's positivity)
singlePlaquettePartition_le — Z(β) ≤ e^β·π/2 (the renormalised weight is dominated by the free case, the contraction's normalisation bound)
strong_coupling_iterate_contracts — the n-fold block-spin contraction e^(−nκ) → 0 (the RG iteration's strong-coupling decay)
